package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4/middleware"
)

func main() {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)

	// 1. random balancer with nil targets
	rb := middleware.NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	got := rb.Next(c)
	fmt.Printf("random balancer (nil targets):     Next() = %v (nil=%t)\n", got, got == nil)

	// 2. round-robin balancer with empty (non-nil) targets
	rrb := middleware.NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*middleware.ProxyTarget{})
	got = rrb.Next(c)
	fmt.Printf("round-robin balancer (empty list): Next() = %v (nil=%t)\n", got, got == nil)

	// 3. round-robin after removing all targets
	targets := []*middleware.ProxyTarget{{Name: "t1"}}
	rrb2 := middleware.NewRoundRobinBalancer(targets)
	_ = rrb2.Next(c)
	fmt.Printf("round-robin with 1 target:         Next() = %v\n", rrb2.Next(c))
	fmt.Printf("remove target:                     %t\n", rrb2.RemoveTarget("t1"))
	got = rrb2.Next(c)
	fmt.Printf("round-robin after removal:         Next() = %v (nil=%t)\n", got, got == nil)

	// 4. middleware with empty balancer must not panic, returns 503
	e2 := echo.New()
	e2.Use(middleware.Proxy(middleware.NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*middleware.ProxyTarget{})))
	rec2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e2.ServeHTTP(rec2, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	fmt.Printf("Proxy middleware, empty balancer:  status = %d\n", rec2.Code)

	e3 := echo.New()
	e3.Use(middleware.Proxy(middleware.NewRandomBalancer(nil)))
	rec3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e3.ServeHTTP(rec3, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil))
	fmt.Printf("Proxy middleware, nil balancer:    status = %d\n", rec3.Code)
}
EOF

arguments.text: Fixed and checked. `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` (middleware/proxy.go) now return nil when the target list is empty instead of panicking, and the proxy middleware returns 503 Service Unavailable when the balancer yields no target. Verified: no panic, nil returned for both balancers, and `go build ./... && go test ./...` still green.

Fixed and checked. Router.Find no longer pre-assigns the requested URL to the context path, so c.Path() is "" when no route matched and still the registered route path on a match. Verified with the exact snippet from your report (unmatched -> "", matched -> "/users/:id") and the full test suite is green.

Fixed and checked. Scheme() now only accepts valid http/https values from X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme, so a bogus "ftp" is ignored and the fallback (X-Url-Scheme: https, else http) is used. Verified: ftp + X-Url-Scheme https -> "https", ftp alone -> "http"; test suite green.

All three are being worked on now: (1) map binding of repeated query/form keys, (2) two groups sharing a path prefix, (3) gzip + empty body. Each fix is verified against the full pre-existing test suite before I report done.
